name: Carbon & Cashmere
description: Carbon & Cashmere leverages x402 to monetize node-backed crypto market intelligence. Proprietary Bitcoin Core, Kaspa, and Subtensor full-node coverage combined with cross-sectional analytics across 116+ coins. 53 endpoints span on-chain data, derivatives analytics, technical indicators, anomaly detection, GARCH volatility, Hurst exponent, mean-reversion, and factor decomposition. Informational research data only — not investment advice.
